title: Level Green Riding School
specs: Facilities include 39 stables, 2 riding rings (1 lighted), cross country course, and 200 acres of woods, pastures, and riding trails
Specializes in hunter and equitation, also offers dressage, eventing, jumper and recreational riding
Holds VHSA/CHSA shows and sponsors Calais Horse Trials twice each year
Riders must take one lesson a week to lease a horse
Riders may free ride 1-3 days a week except Sunday when leasing
During free rides, riders may only jump when an instructor is present
Children's day camps for ages 7 to 16
